t: Ultra-thin Japanese washi paper masking tape for delicate surfaces. Specifically designed to prevent bleed-through, creating razor-sharp paint edges. 7-day UV resistance on indoor surfaces exposed to sunlight, such as window outlines. 7-day clean removal from delicate surfaces such as freshly painted walls, plastered walls and wallpaper. 14-day clean removal from common indoor surfaces like glass, wood and PVC. Compatible with most water and solvent-based paints.
